benefits.name: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% bonus on points earned on paid stays, late checkout when available, a welcome gift, and room upgrades when available.

benefits.name: 15 Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status, credited each calendar year.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: Free Night Award certificate worth up to 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points each card renewal year. An additional Free Night Award is granted after $60,000 in purchases within a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Can be topped up with up to 25,000 personal points toward a higher-value property. Second award requires $60,000 in eligible purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage in the U.S. for damage or theft of most rental cars, covering the deductible and remaining damage up to $50,000 after personal auto insurance.
benefits.terms: Rentals must be 30 consecutive days or fewer. Excludes cargo vans, motorcycles, off-road vehicles, limousines, and antique cars. Personal injury and third-party liability not covered.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Coverage for carry-on bags up to $1,250 per person and checked bags up to $500 per person (secondary to airline coverage) when the fare is paid with the card.

benefits.name: Global Assist Hotline
benefits.description: 24/7 emergency assistance and coordination services while traveling, including medical and legal referrals and missing luggage assistance.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
Restaurants worldwide, U.S. gas stations, U.S. wireless telephone services purchased directly from providers, and U.S. purchases for shipping.
